t.zh: 一句真实的话：词典里不是每个词都有，人名、新词常常查不到。查不到的部分，就一个字母一块地切，只是每个字母都很贵。
t.en: A real sentence: not every word is in the dictionary, and names and new words often aren’t. Whatever can’t be found is cut one letter to a piece, at a high price per letter.

t.zh: 这样每一句都切得开，而认识的词总是更省。
t.en: That way every sentence can be cut, and known words are always cheaper.

goal.zh: 算出每句话最省的切法要花多少代价。
goal.en: Work out what the cheapest cut of each sentence costs.

how.zh: 单个字母的代价写在词典最后。
how.en: What a single letter costs is shown at the end of the dictionary.

hints.zh: 单个字母也是一块，代价在词典里写着。
hints.en: A single letter is just another piece, with its cost in the dictionary.

body.zh: 中文没有空格，输入法和搜索引擎都要先分词，用的就是这块电路板：每个切点试一遍，加上这一块的代价，取最省的。
body.en: Chinese has no spaces, so input methods and search engines segment words first, with this very board: try every cut, add the piece’s cost, keep the cheapest.

body.zh: 「最少几块」<level-ref to="wordcost"></level-ref>都是它的特例：代价全是 1，或者没有单字母兜底。
body.en: “The fewest pieces” and <level-ref to="wordcost"></level-ref> are its special cases: every cost 1, or no single letters to fall back on.
